      To-Do Reports

      A report is made when every step of a task is finished. It is removed after 7 days, so save or print it first.

      To-Do List

      Website Links

      Tap Copy to copy a link and send it to your staff.

      Task workflow

      For tasks that go together and have the same steps, only a different name or note (for example two reports sent to the manager in one email). The steps are ticked once for all of them.
      Choose a department and/or group. Leave "All" if it is for everyone. When you filter the To-Do List by department or group, you will only see its tasks.
      Examples: Monthly Report, Daily Print. You can filter the To-Do List by type.
      Examples. THIS: in January you do the January report. NEXT (early): in January you already print the documents for February. LAST: in February you finish the report for January. The deadline day above is always a day in the month when you do the work.
      Older periods before this are ignored, so you do not get old red tasks.
      Write each step in its own box (any length). Choose a date for the step if it must be done on a certain day. For a monthly task only the DAY of the date is used, and it repeats every month. You can tick the steps in any order.
      Your tasks are private: only you see them. Tick accounts here to share this task. Shared accounts see the task and can tick its steps, but cannot change or delete it.

        Face Attendance

        Employees scan their face on their phone. Check-in, leave requests and check-out are decided automatically from each employee's shift and the time of the scan.

        Employee scan page:

        ActionsTimeIDName ShiftTypeAll scans of the dayLate (hrs)OT (hrs) Leave (hrs)LocationPhotoSource

        Enroll a face

        Enter the employee, start the camera, then capture at least 3 angles (straight, slightly left, slightly right). Only that employee should be in view.

        Employee: enter the 3-digit security code from your card to turn on face attendance.

        Enrolled employees

        ActionsIDNameAnglesEnrolled on

        Shift rules

        Times for each shift. A check-out window opens at the shift end plus each overtime hour listed (for example 0,1,2,3). H (rest day) needs no settings: scans on an H day are ignored.

        ShiftStartEndBreak startBreak endOvertime hours (comma separated)

        General settings

        Automatic Attendance and leave-form reminders

        Both switches are OFF by default. Nothing changes in your daily routine until you turn one on.

        On the Attendance page, working and overtime hours are filled in from the scans. You still check them and press Submit.
        Leave Records lists employees who worked less than a full day but have no leave record yet.

        Special early check-out

        For example pregnant or disabled employees: between the two dates they may check out this many minutes early and still get full working hours.

        Manual entry

        Use this when a scan is not possible (for example after the last check-out window has closed). It is saved like a scan and marked as Manual.

        Daily attendance report

        Export a finished day (normally the next morning, after 7:00 AM). The PDF opens in a print window - choose "Save as PDF".

        Signatures

        Type the title of each signature box, for example Prepared by, Checked by, Approved by. A box with an empty title is not shown. Type a name under the line only if you want it printed.

        Excel: the header lines are left-aligned. Signature boxes follow the position you choose.

        Export

        Choose what to export, fill in the document details, then export it as PDF, Excel or Word. The Export buttons on each page still download directly.

        Master Sheet Settings

        Both switches are off until you turn them on. Dates and hours can always be edited by hand.
        When an employee's AL End Date has passed, the next year is filled in: the new start is the day after the old end date, the new end is one year later. Example: 2025.01.01 - 2025.12.31 becomes 2026.01.01 - 2026.12.31. Used hours and carried forward are not changed. Resigned employees are skipped.
        Fills the Entitled Hours from the table below when a new AL year starts, and suggests it when you add or edit an employee. Existing hours are only changed when a new AL year starts or when you press the button further down. Your manual edits are never overwritten in between.
        Use the same number as the "Years of Work" column: 0 = the first 12 months, 1 = one full year, and so on. The benefit starts from day one. Example: 0 - 2 = 144, 3 - 5 = 152, 6 - 8 = 160. Leave "To" empty for "and above".
        Make the table from a formula (optional)
        This replaces the whole table above.
        Employees whose AL cycle has ended
        With the first switch on, these employees are renewed when you press Save settings. After that it happens by itself.

        AL Check

        Every employee, and whether the automatic AL renewal and entitled hours will work for them. Nothing is changed here.
